dct_description_sm: There are 7 sites in Copeland Forest.  We monitor each month from April until December to ensure that there are no major changes in water quality.  We use LaMotte kits to measure Oxygen, Nitrate, Phosphate, Alkalinity, pH, Turbidity and Temperature.  Once a year we test for E. coli (not included in this dataset).
dct_title_s: Friends of Copeland Forest Water Quality Testing
